thread:
maya: Hey team — final check on SDK v3.2 rollout tomorrow. Quick plan below.

alex: Timeline? any preferred freeze window?

maya: Deploy window 02:00-03:00 PST, canaries at 02:10 -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Will keep rollback ready.

sam: Who's owning smoke tests and where are the runbook steps?

jordan: I'll own smoke for server-side bindings. Need test token and a short checklist.

maya: @jordan test token shared in 1Password path (team/eng/platform/sdks). Smoke checklist: 
- auth flow (token refresh)
- streaming responses and chunking
- error codes parity (400/401/429/5xx)
- backward compat: header `X-Client-Version` fallback behavior

priya: For client comms, doc draft is in #docs: https://go.redwood/docs/sdk-v32-notes — includes migration notes and sample snippets.

alex: Any blockers in the API contract? Are there breaking changes we need to call out?

maya: Noted change: `generateStream()` now includes `streamId` in metadata. Non-breaking; clients can ignore if absent. Also we removed deprecated param `max_tokens` alias — server still accepts it but emits a warning header `X-Deprecated-Param: max_tokens`.

sam: We need a rollback signal. Proposal: if error rate > 2% sustained over 5m OR P95 latency > 2x SLO for 3m, we rollback to v3.1. Rollback owners: maya + infra oncall.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-09-14 02:00 PST by maya. Canary steps enabled.

maya: I'll trigger the canary, alex will watch telemetry dashboard. priya please push client advisory to staged customers once we hit 50%.

priya: Copy. Draft ready; will schedule send at ~02:20 PST. Also will post short note to #customers-staging.

jordan: Quick request — can we add a tiny server-side snippet to the docs showing stream handling? e.g.
```js
client.generate({ prompt })
  .on('data', d => console.log(d))
  .on('end', () => console.log('done'))
```

alex: Got the dashboard alert query: `sum(errors)/sum(requests) by model` — alert configured and will notify eng-platform.

maya: Great. If no objections, proceeding with merge + deploy. Any final code review pings?

sam: One small nit in tests, pushed patch to PR #4321. Nothing blocking.

maya: Thanks — I'll merge after green CI and coordinate canary.

deploy-bot: canary started at 02:10 PST. 10% traffic route -> canary monitor active.

alex: 02:15 telemetry looks good. latency Q95 within SLO, error rate 0.3%.

maya: Advance to 50% now.

deploy-bot: advanced to 50% at 02:21 PST.

priya: advisory sent to staged customers at 02:22 PST :mailbox_with_mail: (link in #docs).

jordan: server smoke all good. no exceptions in logs, KV cache warm.

sam: tests green across canaries. no regression in core bindings.

alex: monitoring steady. error rate 0.4%, latency stable.

maya: rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: rollout complete at 02:35 PST. 100% traffic on v3.2.

maya: Thanks everyone. Post-rollout notes: watch for client warning logs about the `max_tokens` alias; priya and docs team will include migration snippet. We'll schedule deprecation announcement next week.

priya: Will update release notes and send final comms to customers and partner teams.

alex: Closing thread. Nice work team! :tada:
